thread:
sana: Heads-up — team dinner in Seoul next Wed evening (Gangnam). Quick options: late-night KBBQ, vegan bibimbap place a friend swears by, or a small-plates izakaya. Who's in and any hard dietary restrictions? :raising_hand:

liam: In for KBBQ if there's a veggie side. :meat_on_bone: not picky about time.

gita: Vegan bibimbap sounds great for me. Also allergic to peanuts fyi.

jordan: Peanut allergy noted — thanks Gita. I vote izakaya for variety, but KBBQ is classic.

kevin: KBBQ for me too. Do we need a reservation for a group of 6-8?

sana: Good q — will try to book. If KBBQ, I found two places: `HanSooyoung BBQ` (Gangnam-daero 123) — busy after 8pm, tel: 02-555-0123 — and `Mapo Flame` (near Sinnonhyeon) with private room options. Links: https://maps.app.goo.gl/hansooyoung  https://maps.app.goo.gl/mapoflame

aisha: Vegan bibimbap spot is called `DalBap` — tiny, need to reserve early. Menu is 100% plant-based and they label sesame/peanut. https://dalbap.example/menu

liam: I'm fine with whatever as long as there's a tofu or grilled veg option. Also can't stay too late (flight early next am).

jordan: If we do izakaya, `Sora` has lots of small plates and a quieter vibe — good for talking. Not great for big groups though.

sana: Quick poll — react with :one: for KBBQ, :two: for Vegan Bibimbap, :three: for Izakaya. I'll tally by EOD.

lunchbot: Poll created: KBBQ (1), Vegan Bibimbap (2), Izakaya (3). Poll link: https://slack.com/poll/abc123

kevin: :one: KBBQ

aisha: :two: Vegan Bibimbap — can we confirm peanut-free?

gita: :two: thank you!

liam: :one:

jordan: :three: but :one: is fine too

sana: Current tally: 2 votes KBBQ, 2 votes Vegan, 1 Izakaya + 1 undecided. Given the peanut allergy and two veg votes, leaning to booking a place that can do both — private room at `Mapo Flame` can do veg platters on request. Shall I book 7pm?

gita: 7pm is perfect. Thanks for checking veg options.

kevin: Works for me. If anyone needs to duck out early, we can aim to finish by 9:30.

liam: I can stay until 9, happy to join for the first course.

sana: Cool — I'll book for 6 people at 7pm at Mapo Flame and request a veggie platter and nut-free prep for Gita.

lunchbot: Reservation created: `Mapo Flame` Wed 7:00pm for 6. Confirmation: RF-9482. Add to calendar? (yes/no)

jordan: yes please add

aisha: yes to calendar, and can someone grab a taxi share from the office? I can chip in.

liam: I'll take the first cab — ping me in #random 10m before leaving.

sana: Awesome — thanks team. I'll drop the booking details and address in #travel once I get confirmation photo. :thumbsup:

kevin: Also pro-tip: if you want cheaper lunch in Gangnam next day, `Gukbap Alley` on Gangnam 3-ga is great and open early. Not part of dinner but filing for future reference. :ramen:
